name: Norn's Dine
source:
Asahi is a young man who lives in the defensive city of Asgard. He inherited his grandmother's restaurant, "Norn's Dine", which was named after the goddess of "fate". He spent his days as a chef, well-liked in the community for his skill and friendly personality.

In order to satisfy the appetites of people who live their lives to the fullest and to have the energy to survive another day, he uses his skills to cook a wide variety of dishes every day. Through encounters with different people and "fate", things start changing little by little.

Sometimes denying it, sometimes accepting it, the gears of "fate", which had been stagnant like the rest of the world, begin to turn. This is a story of "fate" and the bonds that Asahi forms with the people he meets at the "Table of Fate'' (Nornsdyne).
translation:
Asahi是一位住在防御城市阿斯加德的年轻人。他继承了祖母的餐厅“Norn's Dine”，该餐厅以“命运”女神的名字命名。他作为一名厨师度过了余生，因其精湛的技艺和友善的个性而在社区中广受好评。

为了满足过日子的人们的口腹之欲，为了有精力继续度过新的一天，他每天都用自己的手艺烹制出各种各样的菜肴。通过与不同的人和“命运”的相遇，事情开始一点点发生变化。

时而否认，时而接受，原本和世界其他地方一样停滞不前的“命运”的齿轮开始转动。这是一个关于“命运”以及朝日与他在“命运之桌”（Nornsdyne）遇到的人们结下的羁绊的故事。
